images.title: The top from the bottom row
images.purpose: Shows the top of a three row pyramid written in terms of the bottom row letters.
images.composition: Six rectangular boxes stacked as a pyramid with letter expressions instead of numbers.
images.exact_structure: Six equal rectangular boxes stacked as a pyramid: three in the bottom row, two in the middle row, one on top, each upper box centred over the join of the two below; white fill, dark outlines. Bottom row holds a, b, c from left to right. Middle row holds a + b and b + c. Top box holds a + 2b + c. Every b and the 2b are drawn in reddish purple #CC79A7; a and c stay dark. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The middle number of the bottom row counts twice at the top.
images.description: Shows the top of a three row pyramid written in terms of the bottom row letters.
images.context: Picture for the top in terms of the bottom row.

image_decisions.why: Following the purple b up both sides of the pyramid shows why it is counted twice.
